jobs.description:
Do you speak and understand Dutch and/or English, like to be physically active, and want to earn €15 per hour (plus shift allowance)? If so, this is the vacancy for you! In Venlo at UPS they could use your help as warehouse worker. Keep reading to find out more!

What you'll be doing

Your exact tasks as logistical worker at UPS depend on which department you will be joining. For example you could be working at Inbound, Outbound, Orderpicking or Warehouse operations.

Your working activities will look something like:

    - Receiving, checking, and processing incoming goods
    
- Picking and preparing orders for shipment
    
- Scanning and registering products using a handheld scanner
    
- Sorting, packing, and repacking goods
    
- Loading and unloading trucks
    
- Performing inventory management and logistical administrative tasks

In the UPS warehouse, you will work with a wide range of products, including medical supplies, high-tech goods, and consumer items. It is important that you work according to the safety and quality guidelines. Depending on the department, you will work in a standard warehouse environment or a temperature-controlled area. To be able to work safely you will get the right protective clothing and instructions.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.00 per hour
    
- Shift allowances based on shifts worked
    
- Travel allowance
    
- Full-time job (40 hours per week)
    
- Temporary contract via Manpower with the possibility of a contract with UPS based on performance
    
- Development opportunities via the Manpower Academy (over 200 online training courses)
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Internal training and career advancement opportunities
    
- Working within an international logistics organization with an informal atmosphere

    - Good command of Dutch and/or English for workplace communication
    
- Physically capable of performing warehouse tasks
    
- You work accurately and have an eye for quality
    
- You are flexible and happy to

Looking for a logistics role in a state-of-the-art high-tech environment? Join an innovative organisation and help keep tomorrow’s technology moving. Wie zoeken we? MBO Level 2 or 3 diploma in Logistics or a related field At least 2 years of experience in logistics or a similar working environment Valid EPT certificate Interest in logistics processes within a high-tech environment Good command of the English language Willingness to work in a two-shift schedule Willingness and ability to travel to the Eindhoven region for work It is desirable that you work accurately and independently and have a strong focus on quality. You are proactive, hands-on and flexible when it comes to different tasks and departments. You communicate effectively, take responsibility for your work and enjoy working together with colleagues in a dynamic and international environment. Wat bieden wij je? Gross monthly salary of approximately €4,023, including 25.1% shift allowance and 0.65% ADV allowance 8% holiday allowance 13th month salary Annual bonus based on company results 27 vacation days per year Travel reimbursement Working in a modern and internationally renowned high-tech environment Opportunities to work across different logistics departments and processes Long-term career and development opportunities A professional and international working environment where innovation, quality and teamwork are central Functieomschrijving For an internationally renowned high-tech organisation, we are looking for motivated and experienced Logistics Employees. This vacancy is advertised in the Weert region; however, the work will also take place in the Eindhoven region. Therefore, it is essential that you are willing and able to travel to the Eindhoven region for work. You will work in a modern and dynamic high-tech environment where logistics plays a crucial role in the overall production process. There are several departments and logistics teams within the organisation. Based on your experience,

skills and interests, we will look together at which department and role suits you best. As a Logistics Employee, you contribute to the smooth and efficient flow of materials, components and products. Depending on your department, your responsibilities may vary, but accuracy, quality and teamwork are always essential. Your responsibilities may include: Transporting and moving materials and components within the facility Preparing materials and products for production or further processing Checking materials for quality, completeness and correctness Loading and unloading incoming and outgoing goods Managing and organising materials, tools and components Cleaning and packing products according to established procedures Working with logistics equipment such as an EPT Supporting colleagues with various logistics activities Following strict quality, safety and working procedures Contributing to an efficient and well-organised logistics process

As a warehouse employee logistics, you are indispensable in the logistics process. You work full-time day shifts from 06:30 to 15:15 and make sure everything runs smoothly. In this role, you have lots of freedom to suggest improvements and plenty of opportunities to grow. You work with modern equipment and follow training to obtain or renew your certificates. The position is structural, so there’s a chance for a permanent contract if it’s a fit for both sides.

You start your working day by receiving and checking goods. Then you pick orders, prepare materials for production, and keep the warehouse tidy. You operate the reach truck and stacker and process incoming and outgoing goods with a handheld scanner. In between, you discuss process improvements with colleagues or help pack production orders.

Are you ready for an active job as a warehouse employee logistics in Eindhoven? Apply quickly and experience the benefits of a great workplace where you can develop yourself!

As a Service Delivery Employee in Venlo, you work for a large logistics provider. You work 40 hours a week. You are the contact person for clients and carriers, both in the Netherlands and internationally. In this role, you have a lot of client contact, spot bottlenecks, and come up with solutions. You make sure everything runs according to agreements and keep clients satisfied. This makes the job varied and challenging.
Your day starts with checking ongoing transports. You create reports and monitor the goods flow. You solve problems quickly, for example in case of damage or delays. You work with a transport management system (TMS), keep records, and make sure all customs documents are correct. You think about how processes can be improved and share your ideas with the team.
This job is perfect for you if you like variety and working with people. You work independently but also help colleagues when needed. You get room to grow, learn new things, and develop your talents. Apply today if you’re ready for a new step! 🚀

- Bachelor’s degree working and thinking level, preferably in transport or logistics

- 1 to 5 years of relevant work experience

- Knowledge of international transport, logistics, customs regulations, and import & export

- Experience with logistics administrative tasks

- Good communication skills in Dutch and English

- You are accurate, stress-resistant, and solution-oriented

- You work independently and enjoy working in a team

- Good knowledge of Outlook, Excel, and TMS

- Experience with BlueRock is a plus

Do you want to work as a Production Worker in the food production industry in Zoetermeer? In this role as Production Worker, you and your colleagues help produce and package meat products. You work in a modern production environment where hygiene and quality are important. As a Production Worker, your work is varied and the results of your work are visible right away.

What you get in this job

- Hands-on work in a production environment
- Working together with colleagues in a close team
- The chance to learn different production tasks
- Opportunities to grow into roles such as machine operator

Your shift starts early in the morning in the production area. You check in with your team and get ready for the day’s production. Together you make sure everything runs smoothly so the products are processed and packed on time. Because the company works with fresh products, flexibility during the workday is important.

As a Production Worker, your tasks include:

- Packing products so they are ready for transport
- Working in different departments such as production or seasoning
- Operating and maintaining production machines
- Keeping your workspace clean and safe
- Thinking along about improvements in the production process

You enjoy practical work and like working with colleagues to create products people enjoy.

Enjoying practical work and being part of a team is important for this role.

Requirements:

- Availability for at least 4 days per week
- Ability to communicate in Dutch and/or English
- Ability to work in a food production environment

Preferred:

- Previous experience in production work
- Interest in working with machines
- Accurate and hygienic way of working

Your main tasks are:

- Gear:: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery – delivery bag, helmet and phone holder
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one

•            You speak either Dutch or English

•            You have your own bicycle, or e-bike,

Are you a hands-on professional with a keen eye for order, safety, and efficiency? As a Logistics Operator, you ensure that all raw materials, packaging supplies, and finished products are delivered to the right place at the right time. Working independently in a dynamic production environment, you are the crucial link between the warehouse and the production lines. With a salary of up to €3,500 per month including shift allowance in a 3-shift system, you are also well rewarded for your efforts!

Functieomschrijving:
As a Logistics Operator, you will operate the forklift and carry out a variety of logistics tasks, including:
• Supplying and removing raw and auxiliary materials as well as finished products from the production lines.
• Moving materials between the warehouse, loading docks, and production department.
• Stacking pallets and processing waste streams.
• Completing transport and waste registration forms in line with procedures.
• Cleaning and maintaining logistics tools and equipment.
• Identifying bottlenecks and proposing improvements.

Functievereisten:
You are the right candidate if you:
• Have an MBO-level background.
• Bring experience in logistics or production processes (a plus).
• Hold a valid forklift license, or are willing to obtain one.
• Are flexible, stress-resistant, and take responsibility.
• Have a good command of the English language.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:
In return for your commitment as a Logistics Operator, you will receive:
• A gross monthly salary of up to €3,500 including shift allowance.
• An independent role in a healthy, modern production company.
• Opportunities for internal growth toward Coordinator or Team Leader positions.
• A dedicated team with short communication lines.

Are you looking for a stable full-time position with fixed daytime hours from Monday to Friday? Join the Packaging department at Rhenus and help ensure medical products are processed and prepared safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

- Load and unload incoming and outgoing deliveries
- Perform quality checks on products
- Pick, pack, and prepare orders
- Prepare shipments for safe and timely transport
- Assemble and disassemble wooden crates

Your work plays an important role in keeping daily operations running smoothly and ensuring medical supplies are delivered accurately, safely, and on time.

Who we’re looking for:

- You are able to communicate in Dutch and/or English
- You are reliable, motivated, and eager to learn
- You have some experience in logistics
- You are available full-time (40 hours per week)

Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you looking for a varied job in production? Then the position of Assembly Worker at Kingspan in Gemert is perfect for you.

As an assembly worker, you will work on a production line. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that EPS cool boxes are properly glued together. You will work at different stations. 
At one station, you will glue the sides of the cool box, and at the final station, you will assemble the remaining parts.
You are responsible for checking the final product and applying the correct label. After that, you place the order in the warehouse. Together with your team, you ensure that all products meet the required quality standards.

You won’t stay at the same station all the time—you will rotate with your colleagues, which keeps the work varied and interesting.

What we ask from you:

- You have a good command of the Dutch or English language
- Experience is not required; motivation is more important
- You live near Gemert, Helmond, Deurne, Uden, Venray, or Eindhoven
